message_to_user: Build your data foundations in spreadsheets, descriptive statistics, and SQL basics; data analytics hackathons and competitions will unlock after completing Phase 1 (DA-PH1 Foundations).
Foundations complete! You can now participate in beginner-friendly spreadsheet challenges, data wrangling contests, and campus tech fest analytics tracks.
Core SQL and Python mastered! Target multi-table relational querying challenges, pandas wrangling hackathons, and corporate analytics qualifiers.
Cleaning, EDA and visualization skills unlocked! Compete in national datathons, exploratory data analysis sprints, and statistical visualization contests.
BI modeling and advanced SQL unlocked! Ready for corporate decision science challenges, interactive KPI dashboard competitions, and A/B testing hackathons.
Full portfolio and storytelling readiness unlocked! Target flagship corporate hiring challenges, national hackathon grand finales, and executive analytics presentations.
